int.name: AuthChallengeDecode
int.label: Local protobuf or validation failure while decoding bam_api.AuthChallengeResponse

int.name: ConfigDecode
int.label: Local protobuf decode failure while decoding bam_api.ConfigResponse

int.name: SchedulerEnvelopeDecode
int.label: Local protobuf or scheduler-envelope decode failure while decoding bam_api.SchedulerResponse

int.name: RequestFailed
int.label: HTTP or gRPC request completed with a non-OK status

int.name: Resolve
int.label: DNS resolution failure while resolving the BAM endpoint

int.name: Connect
int.label: TCP connect failure while establishing the BAM transport

int.name: Io
int.label: TLS, HTTP/2, or stream I/O failure on an established BAM connection

int.name: UnsupportedVersion
int.label: Unsupported scheduler-response version received from the BAM peer

int.name: RequestTimeout
int.label: Auth, config, or scheduler-stream gRPC request timed out

int.name: KeepaliveTimeout
int.label: HTTP/2 keepalive PING timed out

int.name: BuilderActivityTimeout
int.label: Scheduler-stream BuilderHeartBeat watchdog timed out while the scheduler stream was live

int.name: InvalidBatch
int.label: Batch rejected because AtomicTxnBatch decode or structural validation failed

int.name: EmptyBatch
int.label: Batch rejected because it contained zero packets

int.name: VoteTransaction
int.label: Batch rejected because it contained a simple vote transaction

int.name: EmptyMessage
int.label: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it contained zero AtomicTxnBatch entries

int.name: OverflowMessage
int.label: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it exceeded the local max batch count

int.name: LeaderStateEnqueued
int.label: Leader-state message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: LeaderStateEnqueueFail
int.label: Leader-state send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: ResultEnqueued
int.label: Result message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: ResultEnqueueFail
int.label: Result send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: HeartbeatEnqueued
int.label: Validator heartbeat message accepted by gRPC stream_send

int.name: HeartbeatEnqueueFail
int.label: Validator heartbeat send attempted on a live scheduler stream but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

int.name: DownToLive
int.label: Scheduler stream accepted: the BAM node sent its first BuilderHeartBeat

int.name: LiveToDown
int.label: Accepted scheduler stream ended

int.name: ClientReset
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because BAM client was reset

int.name: RequestFailed
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream request failed

int.name: StreamEnded
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream ended

int.name: StreamTimeout
int.label: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream timed out

int.name: NotLeader
int.label: Leader-state send suppressed because pack reported no active leader slot

int.name: Expired
int.label: Leader-state send suppressed because slot_end_ns was known and already elapsed

int.name: SlotRegression
int.label: Leader-state send suppressed because the incoming slot regressed behind the latest local leader-state slot

int.name: SchedulerRejected
int.label: Retained leader state cleared because the scheduler rejected it as outside the valid slot range

int.name: FreshWork
int.label: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended after fresh current-slot BAM work arrived before slot end

int.name: NoFreshWork
int.label: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended without fresh current-slot BAM work arriving before slot end

int.name: NoIngress
int.label: No BAM ingress was observed for the slot before its local retention window expired

int.name: FirstBeforeEnd
int.label: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived before slot end

int.name: FirstAfterEnd
int.label: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived after slot end

int.name: UnknownSlotEnd
int.label: BAM ingress was observed for the slot but slot_end_ns was unavailable when the slot aged out of the retention window

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed after slot end

int.name: UnknownSlotEnd
int.label: BAM ingress transactions observed while slot_end_ns was unavailable

int.name: NoIngress
int.label: No scheduler-receive callback has been observed yet for the current leader slot

int.name: SlotEndUnknown
int.label: A first scheduler-receive callback was observed for the current leader slot but slot_end_ns is not known yet

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: The first scheduler-receive callback observed for the current leader slot arrived before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: The first scheduler-receive callback observed for the current leader slot arrived at or after slot end

int.name: Enqueued
int.label: Pong message was accepted by fd_grpc_client_stream_send on a live scheduler stream

int.name: FrameTxBusy
int.label: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but the local HTTP/2 TX frame buffer was not empty, so Pong was skipped

int.name: RequestBusy
int.label: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but a gRPC request body was still sending, so Pong was skipped

int.name: SendFail
int.label: Pong send was attempted on a live scheduler stream after local readiness checks but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

gauge.name: Enabled
gauge.summary: Boolean gauge: 1 when BAM is enabled by operator, 0 when disabled

gauge.name: Healthy
gauge.summary: Boolean gauge: 1 when the BAM client transport, auth, config, scheduler stream, and BuilderHeartBeat recency checks are healthy; otherwise 0. This does not imply that fresh work for the current leader slot has arrived yet.

gauge.name: StreamLive
gauge.summary: Boolean gauge: 1 while the BAM scheduler gRPC stream is open, from its response headers on, 0 otherwise. The BAM node may still reject an open stream; bam_stream_transition counts accepted streams

gauge.name: LeaderStateSlot
gauge.summary: Latest validator leader slot carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots, or 0 if none has been observed yet

gauge.name: LeaderStateTick
gauge.summary: Latest validator leader tick carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots

gauge.name: LeaderStateSlotEndNanos
gauge.summary: Latest validator leader slot_end_ns carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots (nanoseconds), or 0 if unknown

counter.name: TransactionPublished
counter.summary: Cumulative number of transactions published from BAM to verify, including transactions unpacked from bundles

counter.name: AtomicBatchPublished
counter.summary: Cumulative number of revert_on_error AtomicTxnBatch entries published to verify as atomic BAM batches

counter.name: FeedbackResultsDropped
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM feedback results dropped because the local result queue was full, the validator identity or BAM endpoint changed, BAM was disabled, or the BAM node repeated a scheduler stream rejection while no leader slot in the current epoch was known

counter.name: IngressPacketOversize
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM packets rejected because their protobuf data payload exceeded the local transaction MTU

counter.name: BuilderHeartbeatsDecoded
counter.summary: Cumulative number of builder heartbeat messages successfully decoded from the BAM node

counter.name: Failure
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM control-plane or session failures by class. Scheduler payload and AtomicTxnBatch rejects are counted separately in bam_ingress_batch_rejected.

gauge.name: HeapSize
gauge.summary: Total workspace capacity reserved for the BAM tile (bytes). Sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans.

gauge.name: HeapFreeBytes
gauge.summary: Estimated free capacity in the BAM tile workspace heap (bytes). Sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans.

counter.name: KeepaliveAcks
counter.summary: Cumulative number of HTTP/2 keepalive PING acknowledgments received from the BAM node

counter.name: HealthyConnects
counter.summary: Cumulative number of transitions into BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

counter.name: HealthyDisconnects
counter.summary: Cumulative number of transitions out of BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunksTx
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM unary gRPC request bodies (auth challenge and config) fully written to the HTTP/2 send buffer with END_STREAM. Scheduler-stream messages are not counted.

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunksTxBytes
counter.summary: Cumulative number of outbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, before TLS encryption, handed by the BAM gRPC client to the transport

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunksRx
counter.summary: Cumulative number of inbound BAM gRPC message segments processed from HTTP/2 DATA payloads. One DATA frame can yield several segments when it carries several messages or arrives in pieces.

counter.name: GrpcStreamChunksRxBytes
counter.summary: Cumulative number of inbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, after TLS decryption, received by the BAM gRPC client from the transport

counter.name: GrpcRequestsSent
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM gRPC requests started (auth challenge, config, and scheduler-stream calls), counted when the request is queued, whether or not its body has finished sending

gauge.name: GrpcStreamsActive
gauge.summary: Current number of HTTP/2 streams opened by the BAM gRPC client that are not closed, as counted against the BAM node's concurrent-stream limit

counter.name: IngressMultiMessageReceived
counter.summary: Cumulative number of multiple_atomic_txn_batch messages decoded from BAM ingress

counter.name: IngressBatchCommitAttempt
counter.summary: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entries that entered BAM validate/commit

counter.name: IngressBatchPublished
counter.summary: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entries successfully published to verify

counter.name: TransactionRejectedBackpressure
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM scheduler transactions rejected because the pending transaction queue lacked capacity

counter.name: IngressBatchRejected
counter.summary: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entry rejects by reason after decode and batch-level validation. Wrapper-level message rejects are counted separately in bam_ingress_message_rejected.

counter.name: IngressMessageRejected
counter.summary: Cumulative number of multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejects by reason. These count scheduler messages, not AtomicTxnBatch entries.

counter.name: OutboundEnqueueOutcome
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM outbound leader-state, result, and heartbeat fd_grpc_client_stream_send outcomes on a live scheduler stream. Sends deferred because the stream is not live or the gRPC client cannot accept another message yet are not counted.

counter.name: StreamTransition
counter.summary: Cumulative number of scheduler stream acceptance transitions. A stream counts as accepted from the BAM node's first BuilderHeartBeat; one the node rejects after its response headers is counted in bam_failure instead.

counter.name: LeaderPendingDropped
counter.summary: Cumulative number of pending leader-state updates cleared before send because the BAM client reset, the scheduler request failed, or the stream ended/timed out

counter.name: LeaderStateSuppressed
counter.summary: Cumulative number of pack-provided BAM leader-state updates suppressed or cleared because the state was not locally live

counter.name: LeaderPendingReplaced
counter.summary: Cumulative number of pending leader-state updates replaced by a newer leader-state update before send

counter.name: SlotIngressResult
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM slot-ingress records finalized after they aged out of the local retention window, bucketed by the first scheduler-receive callback for that slot relative to slot end or as unknown when slot_end_ns was unavailable

counter.name: SlotIngressTransactions
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM ingress transactions counted in finalized ingress rollups using scheduler-receive callback timestamps, bucketed as before-end or after-end only when slot_end_ns was known at observation time, else unknown

counter.name: HealthyLeaderSlotResult
counter.summary: Cumulative number of local leader slots that reached slot_end_ns while BAM status was CONNECTED_HEALTHY, bucketed by whether fresh current-slot BAM work had arrived before slot end

counter.name: SchedulerPongSendOutcome
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send outcomes, including local send-boundary contention and live-stream fd_grpc_client_stream_send results

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttSample
gauge.summary: Latest HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time sample captured at scrape time (nanoseconds)

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttSmoothed
gauge.summary: Exponentially smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time estimate (nanoseconds)

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttDeviation
gauge.summary: Smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive RTT variation estimate (nanoseconds)

gauge.name: KeepaliveRttValid
gauge.summary: Boolean gauge: 1 after the first HTTP/2 keepalive RTT sample has been observed, 0 before RTT estimates are initialized

gauge.name: FeedbackQueueDepth
gauge.summary: Current number of BAM feedback results buffered for send

gauge.name: PendingTransactions
gauge.summary: Current number of validated BAM scheduler transactions buffered and waiting for bam_verif credits

gauge.name: CurrentLeaderSlotFirstIngressState
gauge.summary: One-hot state for the current leader slot's first observed scheduler-receive callback relative to slot end. Exactly one enum bucket is exported as 1 for the current local view; all others are 0.

histogram.name: BuilderHeartbeatArrivalDeltaNanos
histogram.summary: Distribution of remote BuilderHeartBeat timestamp to local scheduler-stream receive callback delta (nanoseconds); includes clock offset and is intended only for relative trend analysis

histogram.name: SchedulerPongSendNanos
histogram.summary: Distribution of local BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send-boundary turnaround from scheduler-message receive callback to local readiness classification or fd_grpc_client_stream_send outcome on a live scheduler stream (nanoseconds). This is local processing and send-boundary latency, not network RTT.

int.name: NewSeqBeforeComplete
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned because a new sequence arrived before completion

int.name: LeaderSlotEnd
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned at leader slot end

int.name: PohTimeout
int.label: Active BAM bundle abandoned because the PoH leader-slot wallclock deadline elapsed

int.name: SingleOutsideSlot
int.label: Independent BAM transaction invalidated because packing moved outside its allowed slot window

int.name: SingleBlockhashExpired
int.label: Independent BAM transaction invalidated because its blockhash expired

int.name: BundleOutsideSlot
int.label: Fully assembled BAM bundle invalidated because packing moved outside its allowed slot window

int.name: BundleBlockhashExpired
int.label: Fully assembled BAM bundle invalidated because one of its blockhashes expired

int.name: Received
int.label: BAM work reached pack after ingress preprocessing and resolution

int.name: Accepted
int.label: BAM work was accepted into pack's main transaction pool

int.name: RejectedPrePending
int.label: BAM work was rejected before entering pack's pending-work tracker

int.name: PendingEntered
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker after acceptance

int.name: PendingEvicted
int.label: BAM work was evicted from pack's pending-work tracker by later slot or blockhash revalidation

int.name: Scheduled
int.label: BAM work was removed from the pending-work tracker and scheduled into a microblock

int.name: Landed
int.label: BAM work was observed as landed via execution feedback

int.name: CompletedUnlanded
int.label: BAM work completed execution but at least one transaction did not land

int.name: RejectedPrePending
int.label: BAM work was first rejected before entering pack's pending-work tracker

int.name: TrackingRejected
int.label: BAM work was accepted into pack but rejected because the tracked-work table was full

int.name: PendingEvicted
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker and was later evicted by slot or blockhash revalidation

int.name: Scheduled
int.label: BAM work entered pack's pending-work tracker and was later first scheduled into a microblock

int.name: BundleAssemblyAbandoned
int.label: Multi-transaction BAM work was abandoned before full assembly completed

int.name: NoEvent
int.label: No BAM event of this kind was observed before the leader slot finished

int.name: BeforeEnd
int.label: The first BAM event of this kind was observed before slot end

int.name: AfterEnd
int.label: The first BAM event of this kind was observed at or after slot end

counter.name: BamBundleAssemblyAbandon
counter.summary: Cumulative number of in-progress multi-transaction BAM bundles abandoned before full assembly, by reason

counter.name: BamWorkRejectedPrePending
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM transactions or fully assembled BAM bundles rejected by slot/blockhash revalidation before they were accepted into pack's pending-work tracker, by work kind and reason

counter.name: BamPendingWorkEvicted
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM pending-work items evicted after acceptance into pack because slot/blockhash revalidation later failed, by work kind and reason

counter.name: BamWorkItems
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM work items observed at each pack lifecycle stage. Multi-transaction BAM bundles count as one item.

counter.name: BamTrackingRejected
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM work items rejected because the local tracked-work table was at capacity

counter.name: BamTrackingRejectedTransactions
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM transactions rejected because the local tracked-work table was at capacity

gauge.name: BamPendingWorkCount
gauge.summary: Current number of BAM work items tracked in pack's pending-work set after acceptance and before scheduling or cleanup

gauge.name: LeaderSlot
gauge.summary: Current pack leader slot, or 0 if pack is not the leader

gauge.name: LeaderSlotEndNanos
gauge.summary: Current pack leader slot end wallclock timestamp (nanoseconds), or 0 if pack is not the leader

counter.name: BamLeaderSlotFirstInsertResult
counter.summary: Cumulative number of pack leader slots finalized with no BAM insert, a first BAM insert before slot end, or a first BAM insert at or after slot end

counter.name: BamLeaderSlotFirstScheduleResult
counter.summary: Cumulative number of pack leader slots finalized with no BAM schedule, a first BAM schedule before slot end, or a first BAM schedule at or after slot end

counter.name: BamWorkFirstOutcome
counter.summary: Cumulative number of BAM work items bucketed by their first terminal pack outcome

histogram.name: BamWorkRxToFirstOutcomeNanos
histogram.summary: Distribution of BAM scheduler-receive to first terminal pack outcome for a BAM work item, sampled once when that work is first rejected, tracking-rejected, pending-evicted, scheduled, or bundle-assembly-abandoned (nanoseconds)

counter.name: BamConflictBlocked
counter.summary: Scheduling attempts blocked by account conflicts on the selected BAM candidate. Does not establish that a later independent batch was runnable or measure lost earnings.

counter.name: BamUnscheduledAtSlotEnd
counter.summary: Tracked BAM batches still pending when a leader slot closes, retired as OUTSIDE_LEADER_SLOT. Excludes dispatched batches; does not establish validity, schedulability, or lost earnings.

counter.name: BamCapacityDeferred
counter.summary: BAM candidate groups newly deferred for the current block after exhausting the capacity-miss budget. Counts each candidate group's first deferral.

gauge.name: SlotDurationNanos
gauge.summary: Replay's current slot-duration assumption in nanoseconds (0 without BAM)
